title: Pie Chart Anti-Patterns and Proportion Alternatives
description: Guidelines discouraging misleading pie charts and prescribing effective part-to-whole visualizations.
conditions: Communicating part-to-whole proportions and percentage shares of a categorical total
recommended_methods: Horizontal Bar Chart sorted in descending order of percentage
Waffle Chart (10x10 square grid) for intuitive percentage representation
Donut Chart strictly limited to 2 or 3 distinct categories with large contrast
selection_rules: NEVER use a Pie Chart if categories exceed 5 (human perception cannot accurately compare angular slices)
NEVER use 3D Pie Charts under any circumstance (3D perspective distorts relative slice areas)
Replace multi-category pie charts with horizontal bar charts showing exact percentages
limitations: Bar charts do not instantly convey that the parts sum to 100% (mitigate by explicitly titling 'Percentage Share of Total')
Donut charts waste valuable center space unless used to display the total aggregate metric
source: Tufte (2001) The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
